title: A strong recommendation from me.
body:
Har du tidligere brugt alarmer til at huske dig selv på ting? Men ender med at glemme det 2 sekunder efter, at du har trykket ok. Så er denne app nok lige noget for dig. Den vil blive ved med at minde dig om det, indtil du trykker done. Der er masser af indstillinger, og den koster kun 45 kr, er alle pengene værd. En stor anbefaling herfra. 

 English "Have you ever used alarms to remind yourself of things, only to end up forgetting 2 seconds after pressing ok? Then this app is probably just what you need. It will continue reminding you until you press done. With plenty of settings available, and at just 45 kr, it's worth every penny. A strong recommendation from me."
author: Rudi177

title: Great for recurring tasks and reminders
body: Best reminders app for both recurring and one-time activities. Makes tasks more manageable, as I can keep a running list of stuff I need to get done, and know it’ll remind me. The auto-snooze maxing at 1 hour is too short though - hoping they’ll add 3 and 6 hours at some point.
author: LouiseBonde

title: God for ADHD
body:
Fantastisk app for mennesker der glemmer inden for 5 sekunder. 
Med ADHD skal jeg være i nærheden af det jeg skal huske, for at få det gjort, ellers bliver jeg distraheret af andre ting. Det er jeg ofte ikke når jeg bare får 1 alarm og så når jeg at glemme det, inden jeg kommer i nærheden af det. 
Med Due kan jeg blive mindet om det med intervaller, der passer til opgavens beskaffenhed. Det er så fedt.

author: MantisV

title: The old Due was better!
body:
The simplicity from the old version is now gone. Also, you have to pay - AGAIN - for options that was included in the old version, but the developer now again wants money for, ie. snoozing an event for 5 mins.

I have used the old version a lot every day. It really helped me remember a lot of the small things you would otherwise forget. The redesign of the program is not user friendly. It is annoying. And the developers need for extra cash for functions included in the old version makes me so frustrated, that I would rather find another app that satisfies the same need than paying for this app twice!

title: Too simple
body: Shows am/pm for 24-hour timezones. Always shows badge on app-icon with total number of upcoming items, no customization possible. Only simple title line for entries, no extra description field.No support for recurring tasks, no snoozing, no templates for tasks.tl;dr: too simple and too US-centric. It has less features than the built-in calendar and alarm-clock.
